title: Example Orders API
summary: Read and cancel the orders placed at your stores, and receive a webhook whenever an order's state changes.
apisWhy: THE ORDER OF THIS ARRAY IS THE PUBLISHED SIDEBAR ORDER, end to end. Alphabetising it is not a cleanup, it reorders partner-facing navigation.
securitySchemeNamesWhy: The published scheme KEYS only, one per credential, in the order apiKey(...) declares them. Everything else about the schemes — the type, the location, the header name, the prose — is DERIVED from that decorator, because a copy here is a copy the running server never reads.
